data.one_liner: Dart implementation of finite field Diffie-Hellman based on PKCS#3.
data.what_it_does: Provides a pure Dart implementation of finite field Diffie-Hellman cryptographic key exchange based on PKCS#3. Includes support for multiple predefined DH groups and PEM serialization.
use_when: You need to perform Diffie-Hellman key exchanges in pure Dart.
You require support for PKCS#3 standard finite field groups.
avoid_when: You need Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman instead of finite field Diffie-Hellman.
strengths: Pure Dart implementation with no native platform dependencies for cryptography
weaknesses: Limited to finite field Diffie-Hellman based on PKCS#3
